final_message: `cp`’s positional paths lacked variadic argument metadata, so Zsh completed only the first path. Added `.num_args(1..)` to restore completion for destinations and additional sources, plus a regression test. All 262 applicable `cp` tests pass; seven environment-dependent failures also occur without the fix.
assistant_messages:
`cp` declares its paths as a single-value positional, so the generated Zsh completion stops offering files after the first path. I’ll make it variadic, as `mv` already does, and add a completion regression test.
The completion regression now passes. Seven existing `cp` tests failed on permissions, mounts, or filesystem allocation; I’ll compare against the original source to check whether any failures came from this change.
